title: No Kings- No Time to Celebrate
description:
On Flag Day Saturday June 14th, stand with us on the sidewalk at the corner of Maple Street and Lafayette Street (Route 114) in Marblehead from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., for “No Kings- No Time to Celebrate” —a nonpartisan, peaceful stand out to stand up in defense of American democracy.

This is no time to celebrate. America is in a Constitutional crisis. 

The colors of the American flag have been described as “Red for courage and readiness to sacrifice; white for pure intentions and high ideals; and blue for vigilance and justice.” Our Veterans have fought and died to defend our flag and our values and we should not betray their sacrifice. 
On this Flag Day in 2025, we call on those same qualities of American spirit- courage and sacrifice, vigilance and justice- as we defend the pillars of democracy.  We refuse to celebrate when America is in a Constitutional crisis.

Come to this peaceful demonstration. Bring your signs, your friends, your determination—and your belief that the United States was never meant to have kings. Join us!

Organized by the Marblehead Alliance for Democracy.

title: Taking Back Our Power Committee Meeting
description:

We will never have healthcare for all until the political influence of health insurance companies is limited. We will never have clean air and clean water until the political influence of corporate polluters (DTE, Consumers Energy) is limited.

Corporations are drowning out our voices! We need money out of politics. WE WANT ELECTED OFFICIALS TO REPRESENT THE PEOPLE, NOT CORPORATIONS!


**Join Michigan United Action's Taking Back Our Power committee meeting to see what's next for the campaign.** There are big changes coming up and we need all hands on deck. Bring your friends or anyone interested in volunteering! We will be meeting every other week and offering orientation for new folks after this meeting.

title: Statewide Webinar: Supreme Court Review in U.S. v Skrmetti
description:
The U.S. Supreme Court should soon be issuing their decision in U.S. v Skrmetti, a key case involving individual states' efforts to ban essential, evidence-based, gender affirming health care for young people. 

In anticipation of this decision, we at Equality Michigan, along with our partners at the ACLU of Michigan, are offering this statewide virtual webinar to discuss the details and breadth of the decision, as well as how it does and does not impact Michiganders. 

The conversation will feature Emme Zanotti, Equality Michigan's Senior Director of Movement Building & Political Affairs; and Jay Kaplan, the ACLU of Michigan's LGBTQ+ Rights Project Staff Attorney.

There will be a Q&A portion of the webinar, where panelists can answer questions related both to the case, and to some other relevant issues impacting Michigan's LGBTQ+ community. 

In the event that a decision comes sooner in June, we may move this meeting up to more urgently answer your questions and try to address your concerns.

Join the National Democratic Training Committee on Monday, July 14th from 1-2 pm ET for a free virtual live training on **Running an Effective Canvass Operation**. We're here to help, so join us to learn the following:

*   Define canvassing and its use on political campaigns
*   Review the components of effective canvassing scripts

title: Tech Time: Setting Up a Virtual Phone Bank
description:
Join the National Democratic Training Committee on Tuesday, July 22nd from 1-2 pm ET for our free virtual live training: **Tech Time: Setting Up a Virtual Phone Bank.**

  

This session is designed to teach you the technical skills needed to effectively use VoteBuilder to create a virtual phone bank. Unlike our other virtual live trainings, this session focuses more on demonstrating hands-on, hard skills rather than high-level theory and strategy. If you already have access VoteBuilder, there will be opportunities to follow along and practice throughout the session.

  

We’re here to help, so join us to learn the following:

*   Explore the features of VoteBuilder's Virtual Phone Bank tool
*   Demonstrate the process of setting up a virtual phone bank in VoteBuilder

  

**This training is right for you if you're planning or managing a voter contact program using VoteBuilder/VAN.**

title: Pramila Jayapal's Resistance Lab Training 1.0 watch party with Activist Evenings
description:
The Resistance Lab is a series of trainings that are developed specifically for this moment. In this first lab, we look at how non-violent movements around the world have responded to leaders who seize power in authoritarian ways and the most effective tools and tactics to utilize in these moments. We offer frameworks to understand this moment at home, and incorporate interactive conversation with others to help create community and build our resistance movement.

The Resistance Lab was developed with experts who have researched and studied democratic backsliding around the world as well as in the United States and the non-violent movements that have emerged to challenge those authoritarian leaders. We also draw from many toolkits for effective tactics and frameworks as well as from Pramila’s own background leading successful organizing movements for economic and social justice for two decades.

Our goals are to help people understand how democracies fall and the most effective resistance movements that have challenged authoritarians and dictators; to turn anger, fear and frustration into action in the short-term while also preparing for a coordinated resistance movement for the longer term; and to build community across the country that can help grow our movement. At the end of the day, we want to get people strike-ready and street-ready and make sure we protect our people, our freedoms and our democracy.

With Trump and his MAGA billionaires doubling down on their attacks on the economic livelihoods of people to thrive and on our democracy, we can’t afford to sit this moment out. This is about building real power together. And it starts with you.
